subject: Consulting integrator sandbox and onboarding request
messages:
From: Alicia Park <alicia@starlight-consulting.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consulting integrator sandbox and onboarding request

Hi Camila & Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Starlight is ramping two delivery squads to build a Redwood-backed assistant integration for our e-commerce customers and we need a short onramp to be productive next month. Specifically: 

- Sandbox/provisioned environment with model variant and sample dataset (we'll use a dev AWS account)
- Short enablement workshop (2 hours) covering API best practices, cost controls (batching/cache), and rollout tips
- Mutual action plan so we can align timelines, responsibilities, and sign off for an initial pilot

Can you provision a sandbox and share access steps + any onboarding checklist? We can be flexible on the week of Mar 7 for the workshop. I attached a one-pager of our expected pilot scope.

Thanks,
Alicia Park
Partnerships Lead | Starlight Consulting
alicia@starlight-consulting.com

Attachments: pilot_scope_onepager.pdf (stub)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@starlight-consulting.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consulting integrator sandbox and onboarding request

Hi Alicia — great to hear from you and excited to partner on this.

Quick answers / next steps: 
1) Sandbox: we can provision a dedicated dev pool and a sandbox API key scoped to your project. We need a dev AWS account ID and contact email for the service account. Provisioning usually takes 2 business days once we have the info.

2) Workshop: Mar 8 or Mar 9 afternoon PT both work for us. Recommend agenda: 1) API fundamentals + rate limits, 2) batching/cost controls, 3) model selection & quantization tradeoffs, 4) rollout/canary strategies + monitoring.

3) MAP (mutual action plan): I attached a simple spreadsheet template (MAP_v1.xlsx) — fills in owners, dates, and gating items.

Security note: for production pilots we will need to route a short security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence exchange; if you anticipate procurement / legal involvement, flag that now so we can sequence it.

Looping in Sean to own technical provisioning and Karthik for partner enablement coordination.

Camila Reyes
Sr. Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx; partner_onboarding_checklist.pdf (stub)

Camila — thanks, that sounds good.

AWS dev account: 123456789012
Service contact for provisioning: tom.rivera@starlight-consulting.com (Tom Rivera, Infra Lead)
Workshop: Mar 8, 10:00–12:00 PT works for our team. We expect 4 engineers + 1 product manager to attend.

I attached a first-pass SOW we plan to use for the pilot; it's intentionally light. We'll also start the procurement thread with our legal team and will need a short SOC2 snapshot when you ask for it.

Alicia Park
Partnerships Lead | Starlight Consulting

Attachments: starlight_sow_draft.pdf (stub)
